original.title: What to do if your ball is moved by an animal
original.question: A dog runs onto the course and moves your ball from where it was resting. What is the correct action under the Rules?

choices.text: Play the ball from where the dog left it
Replace the ball as close as possible to its original spot, with no penalty
Add a penalty stroke and drop the ball
Skip the hole and move to the next one

original.explanation: If an outside influence, such as a dog, moves your ball at rest, you must replace it as close as possible to its original spot with no penalty.
